Capture, Create, and Share
Your 3D Gaussian Splatting Models
Create high\-quality 3D content from real\-world scans—fast, accurate, and ready to share. Powered by 3DGS, LCC works seamlessly across devices and workflows.
What You Can Do with LCC
Data Production
LCC Studio
Generate, manage, and publish 3D models on your own PC. The built\-in Scene Editor turns a model into an interactive scene, with measurement, annotation, collision detection, flythroughs, view transitions, asset overlay, HD Enhancement, map fusion, and Aerial\-Ground Map Fusion. Private deployment keeps sensitive data in\-house.

\*Actual data size may vary based on capture conditions
Professional Model Editing
LCC Model Editor
Refine raw 3D Gaussian models into production\-ready assets. Multi\-model stitching, duplication, separation, clipping, and global color grading give precise control over the model before it moves into scene editing.
Scene Editing for Applications
LCC Scene Editor
Turn a finished model into a scene people can explore. Scene editing and interaction design come together so what you arrange on screen is exactly what publishes. Edit and publish in one pass.
View and Share Anywhere
Review and present your 3D scenes across devices. Share results with clients or collaborators and explore scenes interactively without high\-end hardware.

XGRIDS provides hardware capture devices and local software tools only. Data is collected, stored, processed, and exported independently by users. XGRIDS does not participate in data collection and does not control or retain custody of user data or outputs.All data capture, processing, and storage is completed on local devices or local software, with no dependency on cloud services.
